title: Men in Suits Conversing Under Tree, 1966 Outdoor B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Captured in March 1966, this black-and-white snapshot depicts an older gentleman in a coat and eyeglasses engaged in a focused conversation with a younger man wearing a dark tailored suit, narrow tie, and horn-rimmed glasses. They stand outdoors beneath the leafy boughs of a large tree, with other formally dressed individuals and modern campus-style architecture visible in the sunlit background, suggesting an academic, political, or civic gathering.
